newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Fugro sells environment units.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Fugro sells environment units.

text.p: Dutch engineering consultancy Fugro said on Monday it had sold some of its environmental activities to ENSR, a U.S. subsidiary of Germany's RWE Group.
"Fugro sold the North and South American and British parts of its environmental division to ENSR Corporation of Acton, Massachusetts, on January 31, 1997," Fugro said in a statement.

It gave no financial details of the sale, which takes retroactive effect from January 1 this year. The units sold to ENSR posted combined turnover of some 68 million guilders in 1996 and employ 370 staff, Fugro said.
Fugro said it had failed to reach agreement with ENSR on the sale of its Dutch, Luxembourg and Nigerian-based environment activities.
"The Environmental Division will continue with activities in Europe and Africa," it said.
The company said last August it was considering selling all or parts of its environment division as it did not meet corporate performance targets.
It said then results at its U.S. and Dutch activities were improving, but that Germany remained a difficult market.
